thread:
maria: FYI I reproduced a weird cancel/leak in the Go SDK generator sampleapp: cancel() doesn't stop chunk delivery when an auth refresh causes a retry.

maria: Minimal repro: 
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
stream, _ := client.Generators.Generate(ctx, req)
// background refresher may rotate token
cancel()
for ch := range stream.Chunks() {
  fmt.Println(ch) // still prints for seconds after cancel
}
```

sam: likely cause: retry builds a new http.Request without req.WithContext(origCtx) so it ignores cancellation.

john: seen this before. If retry uses background ctx the request won't stop.

elaine: quick audit: runtime/retry.go reconstructs the request on 401 and doesn't call WithContext.

maria: short fix = attach orig ctx to retried req (req = req.WithContext(origCtx)) + test. Long term = centralize token refresher so per-request goroutines don't block.

sam: add a tiny README note for generator onboarding showing context.WithTimeout for interactive flows.

ci-bot: buildkite: started pipeline #9123 for branch fix/attach-ctx-on-retry

maria: opened PR with patch, test, and README blurb: https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/pull/389. Please review.

sam: nice catch. :thumbsup:
